title_zh: 改用大号磁性图形演示模型

scenario.label_zh: 改用大号磁性图形演示模型
scenario.goal_zh: 发现后排看不清模型上的数字，并改用大号磁性图形完成可见性检查

context_zh: 两位教师在空教室中准备模型演示，一位站在前面，一位到后排检查视觉效果。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: From the back row, those tiny numbers are almost invisible.

sentences.speaker: Kenji
sentences.text: Would a laser pointer help you follow the model?

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: It would show me where you're pointing, but I still couldn't read the numbers. Could we use larger shapes instead?

sentences.speaker: Kenji
sentences.text: I have these magnetic pieces. I can manipulate them on the board without covering the whole diagram with my hand.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Try the large red circle and the blue square.

sentences.speaker: Kenji
sentences.text: They're on the board now. Can you tell them apart from there?

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Clearly. We don't need the pointer. Let's use those for the demonstration and leave the small-number version in the handout.
